first_error_behavior: Validate calls checkYear first, but that helper only alerts and does not stop. Later branches return on the first active failure. Schedule order is 1 then 2 then 3, quarter 1 through 4, with date/TRA/tax/date-format checks. Save checks only TIN, RDO, and name.

rules.condition: All active checks return no failure.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.

rules.condition: All identifying and amount fields in a quarter row are blank or zero.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.

rules.condition: A populated row has Penalties equal to 0.00.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: No rule requires a positive penalty; it is included only when present.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep penalties optional and typed as nonnegative decimal.

rules.condition: A date uses month 00 with a two-digit valid day and four-digit year.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The lower-bound comparison is month < 0, so 00 bypasses all month-day branches and is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse strictly and require month 01 through 12.

rules.condition: A date component is malformed but the first truthy component is numeric.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: isNaN(result[0] || result[1] || result[2]) tests only the first truthy component; later coercive comparisons catch some but not all malformed forms.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse each component independently without coercion.

rules.condition: A valid changed year is confirmed.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Changing the return period will clear all entered computed data. Do you want to continue?
rules.official_behavior: Confirm clears all three schedules; cancel does not restore the previous year.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a reversible update and restore the prior period on cancel.

rules.condition: Item 11 is switched to No.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.

rules.condition: Neither Item 11 Yes nor No is selected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Validate never requires an Item 11 choice; the static UI defaults No.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require an explicit typed answer when no trusted default is established.

rules.condition: Private category is selected but neither Item 8A option is selected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Validate ignores Item 8A; the static UI defaults No.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require Item 8A when private category makes it applicable.

rules.condition: A nonblank malformed taxpayer email is present.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Email is optional and never format-checked.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Allow blank; validate format when nonblank.

rules.condition: Line of business is blank.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid Line of Business on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: The entire branch is commented out and the field is not serialized in the reviewed save.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Do not present it as an active rule.

rules.condition: Legacy refund fields are inspected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The validation and enable/disable code are commented out; these fields are absent from the reviewed save.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Do not model them as active revision behavior.

rules.condition: Schedule loop reaches an x value other than 1, 2, or 3.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please enter the Date of Remittance for <month>. You may refer to your 1603-Q for the said quarter.
rules.official_behavior: The outer loop only uses x=1..3, so the final else and its literal placeholder messages are unreachable.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Exclude unreachable fallback text from user-facing validation.

rules.condition: Final Copy is requested after validation.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The reviewed encrypted artifact decrypts to exactly the same 105-key inventory as the plaintext save.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve all 105 fields losslessly and keep finalization distinct from transport.

rules.condition: Online transport is invoked.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Transport exists but was not exercised.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep local validation and finalization independently testable.
